description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Tiller Engine each trigger.
Resolve Tiller Engine's ability, untapping Rakdos Carnarium.
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Rakdos Carnarium's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
